meta.usage: A proof that the design swaps as a unit: the default design with a few values changed, for the tests and npm start -- --design proof.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen: the grouped grey in light, black in dark, as the web frame and Home paint it. The top bar sits on it at 88% with a blur.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and popovers. Dark is iOS's own secondary grouped background, so the site, the apps and the board paint the same card.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: the search field, segmented-control tracks, explanation-language pills, table header rows.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Translucent grey over any ground: chips, language tags, the why box, search, segmented tracks, tiles. Text on it reads in body or text; muted reads 4.15:1 on it over bg in light, under the 4.5:1 body text needs.

tokens.name: segment
tokens.usage: The chosen segment of a segmented control, raised on its fill track: the card's white in light, iOS's own raised grey in dark, where surface would vanish into the track (text on it reads 5.1:1 in dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (15.1:1 on bg in light, 17.8:1 in dark). The board's text variable takes these values.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Lead text, snippets and IPA: one step quieter than text (9.8:1 on bg in light, 12.6:1 in dark; 8.6:1 on fill over bg in light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, counts, inactive tabs and segments. 4.7:1 on bg, 4.6:1 on surface-2 in light.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative glyphs alone: chevrons, the dots and dashes that join facts, list bullets, dashed empty-state edges. It reads 2.4:1 on surface in light and 3.4:1 in dark, under the 3:1 of a graphic that carries meaning, so no text, no icon that stands by itself and no control edge takes it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card and chip outlines, table rules, the top bar's bottom edge.

tokens.name: sep
tokens.usage: Translucent hairlines between rows and between table rows, 0.5px on the board and in the apps.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, the chosen explanation language, the active tab underline, the mark's ground. White text on it reads 5.9:1 in light; in dark put bg-coloured text on it (7.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint behind a selected list row and the focus halo of the search field; accent text on it reads 5.1:1 in light and 5.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: The accent at line strength: the 2px rule beside an example, the dotted underline of a variant, a link's underline.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: The right form in a typical error. 4.6:1 on good-soft and 5.2:1 on surface in light; darkened from the website’s #1f8a4c to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the corrected words of a typical error.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: The wrong form in a typical error and its ✕ mark; 5.4:1 on surface in light.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a wrong form when it is highlighted.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Notes that need attention, such as a draft translation. 4.7:1 on warn-soft and 5.3:1 on surface in light; darkened from the website’s #a86a00 to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a warning note.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the frame: a menu's subtitle and hint, a topic's facts line, the marks of an optional word, a slot, a variant and a variety, a table's translation column, the counts of the topics' list.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Quieter than secondary: a topic's chevrons and numbers, a rule's bullet, the joins and gaps in an example, an empty table cell, the dots between a topic's facts.

tokens.name: quaternary
tokens.usage: The quietest glyphs: a Credits row's chevron, the grip that reorders Languages I know, a sheet's grab handle.

tokens.usage: The dashed outline of a topic's box that the level filter leaves empty.
